status_note: All tasks are planned; none have been implemented by this documentation handoff.
effort_note: Relative sizing, not hours or schedule promises.

tasks.title: Inspect repository and preserve existing work
acceptance_criteria: Document current files, scripts, stack and unrelated changes.
Identify the children’s app boundary; do not overwrite an existing Fiqh chatbot module.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Verify dependency and runtime compatibility
acceptance_criteria: Record exact React/Vite/Bun/Elysia/auth/ORM versions actually tested.
Build a minimal Vite frontend and Elysia/auth integration; commit a pinned lockfile.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Assign eligibility, consent and retention decisions
acceptance_criteria: Assign owners for D02/D03/D09/D10 and list unresolved market/risk questions.
Document that production child enrollment is blocked pending approved policy.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Inventory canonical text, audio and curriculum dependencies
acceptance_criteria: List candidate source releases and missing rights evidence separately per asset type.
Assign qualified content author/reviewer roles; do not assert approval.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement tokens and accessible UI primitives
acceptance_criteria: Translate design tokens into actual typography, spacing, focus and button components.
Check intended color pairs and 48-pixel touch targets without using screenshot backgrounds.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Create workspace scripts and CI
acceptance_criteria: Provide lint, typecheck, unit, integration, E2E, contract and build scripts.
CI installs the lockfile reproducibly and runs against a disposable database.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Integrate schemas and public DTO contracts
acceptance_criteria: Validate all bundled positive and negative examples.
Separate staff authoring payloads from child/public serialization, especially answer keys.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement checked database migrations
acceptance_criteria: Generate auth schema and domain migrations with correct foreign keys.
Test clean apply and ownership/completion uniqueness constraints on PostgreSQL.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Create guarded synthetic demo fixtures
acceptance_criteria: Seed only clearly marked non-production data and missing-audio states.
Production startup/publication refuses demo flags, fixtures and test consent methods.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Review trust boundaries and threat cases
acceptance_criteria: Map parent/child/staff capabilities and mounted-auth bypass risks.
Write negative-test inventory for ownership, answer leakage, replay, imports and exports.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Integrate adult authentication
acceptance_criteria: Use the maintained auth library for identity/password/session flows.
Keep secrets server-side; verify auth routes work behind the same-origin proxy.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement email verification and recovery
acceptance_criteria: Unverified account cannot create a real child profile.
Recovery/verification expiry and resend limits have tested safe UI states.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Enforce server-side parent gate
acceptance_criteria: Password reauthentication creates a five-minute server gate.
Entering child mode, expiry and identity changes revoke adult privileges.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Guard the mounted authentication routes
acceptance_criteria: Define a child-mode allowlist for safe auth-library routes.
Direct account/session/email mutation attempts cannot bypass the app parent gate.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement consent and eligibility state machine
acceptance_criteria: Versioned family/child consent actions use server-validated assurance references.
Unconfigured production policy blocks enrollment; demo assurance is local/test only.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement parent-owned child profiles
acceptance_criteria: Nickname/avatar/age-band inputs validate and exclude unnecessary personal fields.
Three-profile limit is race-safe and all CRUD operations are owner-scoped.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement active child and mode switching
acceptance_criteria: Active child is stored in server session context and entering child mode clears the adult gate.
Switch/logout clears audio, query caches and pending personal UI state.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Create scoped repositories and authorization tests
acceptance_criteria: Every private lookup receives authenticated owner context.
Cross-parent read/write/select/delete attempts have consistent denial responses.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Serve one demo lesson through safe serialization
acceptance_criteria: Local-only published-demo view returns only permitted child fields.
No correct options, internal notes, reviewer identities or provider secrets escape.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Create pinned learning sessions
acceptance_criteria: Sessions pin a lesson version and derive child identity from the server context.
Concurrent session creation respects the one-writable-session rule and idempotency.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Accept ordered idempotent learning events
acceptance_criteria: Atomic batches validate session/unit ownership and contiguous sequences.
Identical retries reuse results; conflicting event IDs or sequence gaps fail safely.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Finish sessions and award first-completion stars
acceptance_criteria: Completion requires all server-defined units.
Concurrent/repeated finish returns one completion and at most one logical-lesson star.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build usable child home and demo activity
acceptance_criteria: At 390 px a real continue/start action is visible without squeezing cards.
First-use, resumed, no-content and pending-save states use actual data.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build a real gated parent progress slice
acceptance_criteria: Read real scoped lesson completion and active-time state from database.
Empty data is labeled honestly and reports require a live parent gate.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Prove the end-to-end safe slice
acceptance_criteria: Run adult setup → child lesson → finish → parent report on a real local database.
Exercise alternate-parent IDs, direct parent URLs and replayed completion requests.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement catalog search and filters
acceptance_criteria: Only eligible published content is searchable; no web search dependency.
Debounced search cancels stale requests and has empty/error/no-result states.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement versioned stages and prerequisites
acceptance_criteria: Curriculum graph validation rejects cycles and broken logical lesson references.
Locked states offer a valid next step and stable reporting denominator.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build the single audio controller
acceptance_criteria: Play/pause/loading/buffering/ended/unavailable states are deterministic.
Route switch, profile change and stale media callbacks cannot play/advance the wrong lesson.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement authorized media delivery
acceptance_criteria: Only approved assets entitled by published/current session content receive short-lived URLs.
Private/quarantine/withdrawn assets and arbitrary user-submitted URLs are denied.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement listen-and-imitate steps
acceptance_criteria: Requested audio and one/three repeats work without microphone permission.
Practice acknowledgment is labeled as practice, not pronunciation assessment.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement short-surah and ayah practice UI
acceptance_criteria: Render source-keyed Arabic, attribution and last accepted unit accurately with reviewed staging data.
Missing media/content never falls back to generated recitation or fabricated text.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Assemble private question sessions and public choices
acceptance_criteria: Exactly five eligible reviewed questions/rounds are selected for configured pilot sets.
Public question data omits the correct option and records presentation order server-side.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement first-response scoring and retries
acceptance_criteria: Selected option membership and question/session/version mapping validate server-side.
Retries preserve first-answer correctness and cannot duplicate reward/sequence effects.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build quiz question and completion states
acceptance_criteria: Five-question flow supports keyboard, large choices, feedback and retry.
No timer pressure, hidden answer-key data or ungrounded performance claims.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build five-round sound-matching game
acceptance_criteria: Tap and keyboard interaction work without drag; optional drag shares selection logic.
Playing/feedback/completed views are mutually coherent and use real reward results.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement resume and serial mutation queue
acceptance_criteria: Answers, acknowledgments and heartbeats share ordered per-session submission.
Reconnect replays original IDs; replaced/expired/recalled sessions cannot sync into another session.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Add parent memorization observations
acceptance_criteria: Only the owning gated parent can append an observation for a surah.
Latest observation and history stay separate from automatic practice completion.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement active-time buckets and parent reports
acceptance_criteria: Server caps heartbeats and prevents multi-tab duration duplication.
Weekly totals, quiz denominators, timezone labels and no-data states agree with stored records.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build child achievements
acceptance_criteria: Stars come from unique logical-lesson completion records.
Badges describe practice and contain no ranking, spending, streak loss or automatic hafal claim.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement soft session goals and comfort settings
acceptance_criteria: Parent-selected goal offers a calm break without coercive lockout.
Quiet and reduced-motion settings persist with correct child scope and audio semantics.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Provision staff capabilities and MFA gates
acceptance_criteria: Admin routes require active provisioned role and current MFA evidence.
Content staff cannot read child reports or impersonate families.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement source/rights registry
acceptance_criteria: Store source versions, attribution, evidence, allowed use and reviewer decisions.
Pending/denied/revoked rights block content publication.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement quarantined media upload and verification
acceptance_criteria: Signed uploads are constrained; actual bytes/MIME/size/checksum/decoding are validated.
Unverified files cannot be streamed to child sessions.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build allowlisted source import adapters
acceptance_criteria: Imports use registered source/object/adapter IDs, not unrestricted URL fetching.
Provider credentials/environment permissions are server-only and failures are redacted.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Validate canonical text and audio mappings
acceptance_criteria: Approved source metadata validates verse keys/counts and immutable hashes.
Every pilot segment has recorded human text/audio alignment checks before production.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build structured lesson editor and staff preview
acceptance_criteria: Editor validates units/options/references and shows precise blocking errors.
Draft preview stays staff-only; changes after review require a new candidate/review.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build curriculum release editing and review
acceptance_criteria: Validate order, stage and prerequisite DAG with stable denominator.
Distinct reviewer and immutable release hash are required before publishing.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement review and publish transactions
acceptance_criteria: Author cannot approve their own candidate and published payloads cannot be edited in place.
Rights, hash, audio and question-count failures prevent publication atomically.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement recall and content-status invalidation
acceptance_criteria: Recalled content disappears from new catalog/session/media access.
In-flight sessions stop on the next check with safe return path and historical progress retained.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build parent content reporting and triage
acceptance_criteria: Reason codes and optional short notes are owner-gated and private.
No child audio/photo attachments or public report publication.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement redacted audit trail
acceptance_criteria: Privileged actions include actor, object, request ID, outcome and immutable time.
Audit metadata excludes raw child fields, passwords, signed URLs and support text.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement withdrawal and reconsent enforcement
acceptance_criteria: Family withdrawal blocks all profiles; child withdrawal blocks that profile immediately.
New consent requires approved current flow and revoked sessions cannot continue writing.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement private export jobs
acceptance_criteria: Owner-gated export includes only permitted family data with schema notes.
Downloads expire, enforce ownership and omit secrets/answer keys/internal evidence.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement deletion and backup suppression
acceptance_criteria: Deletion immediately revokes access and idempotent jobs remove active data/objects.
A minimized suppression ledger prevents deleted profiles returning after restore.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Enforce request security and distributed limits
acceptance_criteria: CSRF/origin/cookie/CSP/body-size controls are verified on real routes.
Rate limits remain effective across configured API replicas and do not expose account existence.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement installable shell and explicit offline states
acceptance_criteria: Service worker caches only static shell/assets, not private API/content/media.
Cold offline, in-memory queue limit and reload loss are accurately explained.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Verify responsive and accessible flows
acceptance_criteria: Capture 320/390/768/1024/1440 layouts and keyboard/200%-zoom checks.
Check contrast, tap alternatives, focus, screen-reader feedback and chart table equivalents.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Review actual Arabic rendering
acceptance_criteria: Use reviewed source text with marks on mobile Safari/Chrome and desktop browsers.
No clipped marks, accidental translation, reversed strings or screenshot-sourced glyph content.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Measure performance budgets
acceptance_criteria: Record test hardware/network and actual LCP/INP/CLS/API latency measurements.
Investigate oversized bundles, media latency and unnecessary rerenders; do not report unmeasured targets as results.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Audit logs, frontend bundles and outbound calls
acceptance_criteria: No provider secret, password, answer key or private field leaks to child/public responses/logs.
No ads, tracking pixels, session replay or microphone/camera calls exist in MVP.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement deployment and idempotent workers
acceptance_criteria: Document real environment setup, health/readiness, job leases/retries and rollback.
Production startup validates secrets/policy flags and forbids fixture mode.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Exercise restore and deletion replay
acceptance_criteria: Restore an isolated backup and measure actual RPO/RTO outcomes.
Reapply suppression ledger and verify source pointers/ownership before declaring recovery.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Approve production content rights
acceptance_criteria: Obtain/document actual source, recording, streaming and distribution permissions.
Record approved attribution and any caching/offline restrictions; unresolved rights remain blocked.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Approve pilot curriculum and all mappings
acceptance_criteria: Human reviewer distinct from author checks text/audio/questions and stage sequence.
Evidence references exact release hashes, not generic approval of the app.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Approve market, eligibility, consent and retention policy
acceptance_criteria: Resolve applicable Indonesian 2026 framework and any other launch markets.
Record signed policy/assurance/processor/notice decisions before enabling child enrollment.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Finalize production artwork and missing screen states
acceptance_criteria: Use licensed/original assets with rights evidence, not whole-screen screenshot slicing.
Review onboarding/gate/ayah/privacy/admin states and responsive screenshots not supplied as original concepts.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Run supervised usability pilot
acceptance_criteria: Use the approved participant/consent protocol and record actual task observations.
Assess child navigation and parent interpretation of practice versus memorization without overstating efficacy.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Resolve pilot defects and run complete regression
acceptance_criteria: Attach real automated/manual results for the full requirement matrix.
No unresolved critical/high security issue or known critical content defect remains.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Run production preflight and incident drills
acceptance_criteria: Verify deployment, recovery, source recall, export/deletion and incident contacts.
Confirm no demo records, fake statistics or unapproved source releases are published.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Record explicit human release decision
acceptance_criteria: Each required owner signs the applicable release gates with evidence.
Agent reports remaining limits honestly and does not self-authorize public deployment.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Build the requested public landing page
acceptance_criteria: Preserve the user headline and cover all eight feature benefits in responsive layout.
Parent CTA, privacy/source routes and honest scope do not leak child-mode data.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Implement parent starting-stage and session replacement controls
acceptance_criteria: Only owning gated parent may change starting stage, unlock or replace an active session.
Overrides do not award completion/rewards and replaced session writes are denied.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Test replay, races and reporting invariants
acceptance_criteria: Run concurrent session/answer/finish/profile-create tests against PostgreSQL.
Replay, version change, zero denominator, timezone and heartbeat cases retain correct results.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record

tasks.title: Complete empty/error/permission/recall UI states
acceptance_criteria: Every data screen has tested loading, empty, denied, expired and recoverable-error behavior.
Child content recall/offline paths and parent privacy-job failures remain safe and understandable.
evidence_required: Relevant screenshots or human approval record
